description: Saves the customer's US phone number, which First uses for texts about the service. An empty phone removes it. Confirm the number with the customer before you call this tool, and tell the customer: "By providing your phone number you consent to receiving transactional texts." At the welcome steps, send the phone with finish_welcome_steps instead.

phone.description: A US phone number with 10 digits, or "" to remove it.

name: update_phone
title: Change the customer's phone
